notes: Owner's construction: Open==Low as a SCOUT, with a signal raised only once the ticker is also already up by at least min_chg_pct on the day. Ledger Entry 008 found no edge in Open==Low ALONE (causal form 34.33% against a 35.03% base rate); that result stands and is not what this tests, because scout AND ignition is a different conditional that nothing measured so far speaks to. Targets are the next rungs up the measured ladder from Entry 008 rather than a volatility quantile, which is what produced the trivially close targets recorded in Entry 006. The owner's real question -- which tickers are genuinely strong enough to carry past 10% -- is treated as its own labelled outcome and contrasted against the rest on features observable at signal time only, so any separation found is a lead for a stricter gate rather than an assumed filter.
